source.description: Raster CMYK JPEG card sheets with embedded ICC profile and opacity mask; not vector artwork

conversion.color: Invert Adobe JPEG sample convention, then embedded PDF ICC to sRGB via LittleCMS
conversion.crop: Interior of print trim grid; square printed corners retained
conversion.alpha: Source PDF opacity preserved; third-row cards retain one antialiased bottom edge row, all other crop pixels fully opaque

identityVerification: All 77 printed names reviewed on contact sheets; sequential page mapping also checked against existing 600px card art fingerprints
rights: Card designs, artwork, and printed artist credits remain with their respective rights holders; official public PnP source is recorded, not a new blanket license.
